title: MultiAgent-OPD: End-to-End Training of Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems with On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In a hierarchical multi-agent system, a Leader assigns tasks and subagents carry them out. Jointly training the Leader and the subagents is difficult because a final answer gives only indirect feedback to the subagents. An LLM judge can score the performance of the subagents, but these scores depend on the judge's own assessment of the quality of subagents' responses. We present MultiAgent-OPD, which combines on-policy distillation with reinforcement learning to jointly train a shared-parameter Leader-Searcher-Answerer team end to end. We first train a Teacher in a Searcher-Answerer workflow using answer correctness. During team training, the frozen Teacher scores student-generated search and summary tokens to provide local process supervision for the Searchers, while the Leader learns from team success and the Answerer from candidate correctness. Across seven datasets, the trained system reaches 38.68% macro avg@4, exceeding Prompted Cr

translated_title: MultiAgent-OPD：基于在线策略蒸馏的层次化多智能体系统端到端训练
translated_abstract: 在层次化多智能体系统中，由领导者分配任务、子智能体执行任务。联合训练领导者和子智能体十分困难，因为最终答案只能为子智能体提供间接反馈。虽然大语言模型评判器可以为子智能体的表现打分，但这些分数依赖于评判器自身对子智能体回答质量的评估。我们提出了MultiAgent-OPD，该方法将在线策略蒸馏与强化学习相结合，端到端地联合训练共享参数的领导者-搜索者-回答者团队。我们首先使用答案正确性在搜索者-回答者工作流中训练一个教师模型。在团队训练过程中，冻结的教师模型对学生生成的搜索和总结token进行评分，为搜索者提供局部过程监督，而领导者从团队成功中学习，回答者从候选答案的正确性中学习。在七个数据集上，训练后的系统达到了38.68%的macro avg@4，超越了提示的链式方法（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出MultiAgent-OPD方法，通过将在线策略蒸馏与强化学习相结合，利用冻结的教师模型为搜索者提供局部过程监督，实现了层次化多智能体系统的端到端联合训练。
en_tdlr: Proposes MultiAgent-OPD, which combines on-policy distillation with reinforcement learning, using a frozen Teacher to provide local process supervision for Searchers, enabling end-to-end joint training of hierarchical multi-agent systems.
